articles.summary: LemonSlice has launched its new interactive avatar platform, enabling anyone to upload a photo and start a FaceTime-style call with that character. The photo can be any style - from photorealistic to cartoons to animals. To bring these avatars to life with intelligent conversational agents, Lemon Slice integrated with the ElevenLabs Agents Platform.
articles.title: LemonSlice x ElevenLabs

articles.summary: Interactive video is the future. We raised over $10M seed round to build it. Our interactive video model - Lemon Slice 2 - just launched: real-time talking avatars that stream at 20fps on a single GPU from one photo. Talk to avatars now: lemonslice.com (no signup) Or integrate into your product using our API. ElevenLabs gave AI a voice. We're giving it a face.
